Message:
Bluetooth: hci_sync: Convert MGMT_OP_SET_DISCOVERABLE to use cmd_sync

This makes MGMT_OP_SET_DISCOVERABLE use hci_cmd_sync_queue instead of
use a dedicated discoverable_update work.
